example.en: The rich businessman lives in a mansion in Kifisia.

example.en: Read the manual before using the device.

gloss: olive; olive tree; mole (on the skin)

example.en: Kalamata olives are famous all over the world.

gloss: functional; operating (λειτουργικό σύστημα: operating system); liturgical
